Monkireen-e-Qiyamat, Mushrikeen o Mulhidein

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke kuffaar, mushrikeen, mulhidein kehte hain ke marne ke baad nahi uthaye jayenge. Aye Nabi ﷺ! Tum un se keh do ke haan zaroor uthaye jaoge, phir tumhare tamam chhote bade chhupe khule aamal ka izhar tum par kiya jayega. Suno! Tumhara dobara paida karna, tumhein badle dena waghairah tamam kaam Allah Ta'ala par bilkul aasan hain.

Yeh teesri aayat hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko qasam kha kar qiyamat ki haqaniyat ke bayan karne ko farmaya hai. Pehli aayat toh Surah Yunus mein hai (Tarjuma): "Yaani yeh log tujh se poochte hain ke kya woh haq hai? Tu keh mere Rab ki qasam woh haq hai aur tum Allah ko hara nahi sakte." Dusri aayat Surah Saba mein hai (Tarjuma): "Kafir kehte hain hum par qiyamat na aayegi, toh keh de ke haan mere Rab ki qasam yaqinan aur bilzaroor aayegi," aur teesri aayat yehi hai.

Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah par, Rasoolullah ﷺ par, Noor-e-Munzil yaani Quran-e-Kareem par iman lao, tumhara koi khufiya amal bhi Allah Ta'ala par poshida nahi. Qiyamat wale din Allah Ta'ala tum sab ko jama karega aur isisi liye iska naam Yom-ul-Jam'ah hai, jaise aur jagah hai (Tarjuma): "Yeh logon ke jama kiye jaane aur unke hazir bash hone ka din hai." Aur jagah hai (Tarjuma): "Yaani qiyamat wale din tamam awwaleen aur akhireen jama kiye jayenge." 

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain, Yom-ut-Taghabun qiyamat ka ek naam hai. Is naam ki wajah yeh hai ke ahl-e-jannat ahl-e-dozakh ko nuqsaan mein dalenge. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain, is se ziyada taghabun kya hoga ke unke samne unhein jannat mein aur unke samne unhein jahannam mein le jayenge. 

Goya isisi ki tafseer iske baad wali aayat mein hai ke imandaar aur naik aamal walon ke gunah maaf kar diye jayenge aur behti nehron wali hamesha rehne wali jannat mein unhein dakhil kiya jayega aur puri kamyabi ko pahuche jayenge aur kufr o takzeeb karne wale jahannam ki aag mein jayenge jahan hamesha jalne ka azab pate rahenge. Bhala isse bura thikana aur kya ho sakta hai?

Wohi mukhtar-e-mutlaq hai, na-qabil-e-tardeed sachai. Surah Hadid mein bhi yeh mazmoon guzar chuka hai ke jo kuch hota hai woh Allah ki ijazat aur uske hukm se hota hai, uski qadr-o-masiyyat ke baghair nahi ho sakta. Ab jis shakhs ko koi takleef pahuche woh jaan le ke Allah Ta'ala ki qaza-o-qadr se mujhe yeh takleef pahuchi, phir sabr-o-tammul se kaam le, Allah ki marzi par sabit qadam rahe, sawab aur bhalai ki ummeed rakhe, raza bi-al-qaza ke siwa lab na hilaye toh Allah Ta'ala uske dil ki rahbarisi karta hai aur use badle ke taur par hidayat-e-qalbi ata farmata hai. Woh dil mein yaqeen-e-sadiq ki chamak dekhta hai aur ba-auqaat aisa bhi hota hai ke us museebat ka badla ya us se bhi behtar duniya mein hi ata farma deta hai. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ka bayan hai ke uska iman mazboot ho jata hai, use masaib dagmaga nahi sakte, woh janta hai ke jo pahucha woh khata karne wala na tha aur jo na pahucha woh milne wala hi na tha. Hazrat Alqama ke samne yeh ayat padhi jati hai aur aap se uska matlab daryaft kiya jata hai toh farmate hain is se murad woh shakhs hai jo har museebat ke waqt is baat ka aqeedah rakhe ke yeh minjanib-Allah hai, phir razi-khushi ise bardasht kar le. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke woh Inna Lillahi wa Inna Ilaihi Raji'un padh le. 

Muttafiq alaih hadith mein hai ke momin par taajjub hai, har ek baat mein uske liye behtareen hoti hai. Nuqsan par sabr-o-zabt kar ke aur nafa aur bhalai par shukr-o-ehsanmandi kar ke behtari samet lena hai, yeh do-tarfa bhalai momin ke siwa kisi aur ke hisse mein nahi. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Rasoolullah ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasoolullah! Sab se afzal amal kaun sa hai? Aap ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala par iman lana, uski tasdeeq karna, uski raah mein jihad karna. Usne kaha: Hazrat! Main koi aasaan kaam chahta hoon. Aap ne farmaya: Jo faisla qismat ka tujh par jari ho, toh us mein Allah Ta'ala ka gila-shikwa na kar, uski raza par razi reh, yeh is se halka amr hai. 

Phir apni aur apne Rasool ﷺ ki itaat ka hukm deta hai ke umoor-e-shari'i mein in itaaton se sar-mo tajawuz na karo, jis ka hukm mile baja lao, jis se roka jaye ruk jao. Agar tum iske manne se araz karte ho toh hamare Rasool ﷺ par koi bojh nahi, unke zimma sirf tabligh thi jo woh kar chuke, ab amal na karne ki saza tumhe uthani padegi. 

Phir farman hai ke Allah Ta'ala Wahid-o-Samad hai, uske siwa kisi ki zaat kisi tarah ki ibadat ke laiq nahi. Yeh khabar ma'ni mein talab ke hai yaani Allah Ta'ala ki tauheed mano, ikhlas ke sath sirf usi ki ibadat karo. 

Phir farmata hai chunke tawakkul aur bharose ke laiq bhi wahi hai, tum usi par bharosa rakho. Jaise aur jagah irshad hai: (Tarjuma) Mashriq aur maghrib ka Rab wahi hai, ma'bud-e-haqiqi bhi is ke siwa koi nahi, toh usi ko apna karsaz bana le.

Fa Alhamdulillah.

Allah ki yaad aur daulat irshad hota hai ke ba'az aurtein apne mardo ko aur ba'az aulaad apne maan baap ko yaad-e-Allah aur naik amal se rok deti hai jo darhaqiqat dushmani hai, jis se pehle tanbih ho chuki hai ke aisa na ho tumhare maal aur tumhari aulaad tumhein yaad-e-Allah se ghafil kar dein agar aisa ho gaya to tumhein bara ghata rahega yahan bhi farmata hai ke un se hoshiyar raho, apne deen ki nigahbani un ki zarooriyat aur farmaishat ke poora karne par muqaddam rakho, biwi bachon aur maal ki khatir insan qata-e-rahmi kar guzarta hai Allah ki na-farmani par tul jata hai un ki mohabbat mein phans kar ahkaam-e-islami ko pas-e-pusht daal deta hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ba'az ahl-e-makkah islam qubool kar chuke thay magar zan-o-farzand ki mohabbat ne unhein hijrat se rok diya phir jab islam ka khoob afsha ho gaya tab yeh log hazir-e-Huzoor ﷺ hue dekha ke un se pehle ke muhajireen ne bohat kuch ilm-e-deen hasil kar liya hai ab ji mein aaya ke apne haan bachon ko saza dein jis par yeh farman hua ke in ta'fuwa al-ayah, yaani ab darguzar karo ayindah ke liye hoshiyar raho, Allah Ta'ala maal aur aulaad de kar insan ko parakh leta hai ke ma'siyat mein mubtala hone wale kaun hain aur itaat-guzar kaun hain? Allah ke paas jo ajr-e-azeem hai tumhein chahiye us par nigahein rakho jaise aur jagah farman hai (tarjuma) al-ayah, yaani ba-taur aazmaish ke logo ke liye duniyavi khwahishat yaani biwiyan aur aulaad, sone chandi ke bare bare lage hue dher, shaista ghore, maweshi, kheti ki mohabbat ko zeenat di gayi hai magar yeh sab duniya ki chand roza zindagi ka saman hai aur hamesha rehne wala acha thikana to Allah hi ke paas hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba An-Hazrat ﷺ khutba farma rahe thay ke Hazrat Hasan aur Hazrat Hussain lambe lambe kurte pehne aa gaye dono bache kurton mein ulajh ulajh kar girte parte aa rahe thay yeh kurte surkh rang ke thay Huzoor ﷺ ki nazeerin jab un par parin to mimbar se utar kar unhein utha kar laye aur apne samne bitha liya phir farmane lage Allah Ta'ala sacha hai aur us ke Rasool ﷺ ne bhi sach farmaya hai ke tumhare maal aulaad fitna hain main in dono ko girte parte aate dekh kar sabr na kar saka akhir khutba chor kar unhein uthana para. Musnad mein hai Hazrat Ash'as bin Qais farmate hain Kinda qabeelay ke wafd mein main bhi Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Aap ne mujh se pucha tumhari kuch aulaad bhi hai main ne kaha haan ab aate hue ek larka hua hai kash ke us ke bajaye koi darinda hi hota aap ne farmaya khabardar aisa na kaho un mein ankhon ki thandak hai aur intiqal kar jayen to ajr hai, phir farmaya haan haan yahi buzdali aur gham ka sabab bhi ban jate hain yeh buzdali aur gham-o-ranj bhi hain, Bazzar mein hai aulaad dil ka phal hai aur yeh bukhl-o-namardi aur ghamgini ka baais bhi hai, Tabarani mein hai tera dushman sirf wohi nahi jo tere muqabla mein kufr par jam kar larai ke liye aaya kyunke agar tu ne use qatal kar diya to tere liye baais-e-noor hai aur agar us ne tujhe qatal kar diya to qatan Jannati ho gaya.

Phir farmaya shayad tera dushman tera bacha hai jo teri peeth se nikla phir tujh se dushmani karne laga tera poora dushman tera maal hai jo teri malkiyat mein hai phir dushmani karta hai. Phir farmata hai apne maqdoor bhar Allah ka khauf rakho uske azab se bachne ki koshish karo, Bukhari o Muslim mein hai jo hukm main karun use apni maqdoor bhar baja lao jis se main rok dun ruk jao, ba'az mufassirin ka farman hai ke Surah Al-Imran ki ayat (tarjuma) ki nasikh yeh ayat hai, yaani pehle farmaya tha Allah Ta'ala se us qadr daro jitna us se darna chahiye lekin ab farma diya ke apni taqat ke mutabiq chunacha Hazrat Saeed bin Jabir farmate hain pehli ayat logon par bari bhaari pari thi us qadr lambe qiyaam apni taqat ke mutabiq chunacha Hazrat Saeed bin Jabir farmate hain pehli ayat logon par bari bhaari pari thi us qadr lambe qiyaam karte the ke pairon par waram aa jata tha aur itne lambe sajde karte the ke peshaniyan zakhmi ho jaati thin pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh doosri ayat utaar kar takhfeef kar di aur bhi ba'az mufassirin ne yahi farmaya hai aur pehli ayat ko mansookh aur is doosri ayat ko nasikh bataya hai, phir farmata hai Allah aur uske Rasool ke farmanbardar ban jao unke farman se ek inch idhar udhar na hato na aage barho na peechhe sarko na amr ko choro na nahi ke khilaf karo, jo Allah ne tumhe de rakha hai us mein se rishtedaaron ko faqiron, miskinon ko aur hajatmandon ko dete raho, Allah ne tum par ehsan kiya tum doosri makhlooq par ehsan karo taake is jahan mein bhi Allah ke ehsan ke mustahiq ban jao aur agar yeh na kiya toh dono jahan ki barbadi apne haathon aap mol loge, Wa man yuqa ki tafseer Surah Hashr ki is ayat mein guzar chuki hai.
